title: Seeing inactive parts needs no permission, changing status needs Delete
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. Users: one who can view the inventory list but lacks Delete; one who cannot view the inventory list at all.
custom_steps:
1. As the viewer without Delete, open the Inactive tab.
  2. Confirm they cannot change a part's status.
  3. As the user who cannot view inventory, confirm neither tab is visible.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A user who can view the inventory list can open the Inactive tab and seeing inactive parts needs no extra permission; only changing a part's status needs the delete-level parts permission.
  • A user who cannot view the inventory list at all sees neither tab.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
